recipes.title: Crispy Spicy Chicken Burgers

items.i: each garlic powder and onion powder
plain flour, seasoned with paprika, salt and pepper

steps: Butterfly the chicken into 6 even fillets and toss with the spices, salt and pepper.
Dredge each fillet in seasoned flour, dip in beaten egg, then press into the panko.
Spray generously with oil and air fry at 200°C / 390°F for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through (or bake at 220°C).
Mix the mayo or yogurt with the chopped pickles or jalapeños and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread the sauce on the buns and add lettuce and a crispy fillet. Store the components separately for meal prep and assemble after reheating the chicken.
recipes.notes: Per-burger nutrition (534 cal, 47 g protein, 30 g carbs, 19 g fat; makes 6) is from the creator's card. The video has no captions and the written recipe is on his website, which I couldn't open, so ingredient amounts and timings are estimates based on what's shown.
